title: Open Source Contributor
description:
HAMi: Became a project member of the CNCF sandbox project after 12+ merged pull requests across NVIDIA GPU scheduling, AWS Neuron device support, and the core scheduler
Scheduling: Worked on device plugin behaviour and scheduler policy: how heterogeneous accelerators get filtered, scored, and bound to pods on a Kubernetes cluster
HAMi-core: Contributed to the in-container resource controller that enforces GPU memory and compute limits by intercepting CUDA calls, with no application or driver changes
Reviews: Reviewed 10+ pull requests from other contributors, covering scheduling correctness, device plugin edge cases, and test coverage
Sugar Labs: Landed 2 pull requests in Music Blocks, the browser-based visual programming environment for music and computation used in classrooms
webpack: Contributed to the module bundler that builds much of the web, working across its core packages
Orgs: Active contributor across three organisations — HAMi, Sugar Labs, and webpack

title: Venturelync
description:
Founding engineer: Built the platform from scratch as the first engineer on it, owning architecture, data model, and delivery end to end
Lync Terminal: Designed and shipped Lync Terminal from scratch: modular analytics, custom dashboards, and cached data retrieval so repeat queries stopped hitting the source every time
Integrations: Wired Razorpay, HubSpot, Zoho Books, and GitHub into event-driven workflows, giving the team data sync, payments visibility, and CRM automation without manual steps
Stack: Next.js on the front, Supabase for data and auth, FastAPI behind the analytics layer

title: PandainUniv
description:
Application Tracker: Built the tracker front to back: React.js on the client, a fully serverless AWS backend on AppSync, GraphQL, Lambda, and DynamoDB
Performance: Optimized DynamoDB schemas and GraphQL queries around the access patterns the product actually had, improving backend performance by 30%+
Delivery: Set up CI/CD through AWS Amplify with real-time sync, so every push shipped and clients stayed consistent without a refresh
